question: For the year 2022, who among the following won the Indian Film Personality Award awarded by International Film Festival of India (IFFI)?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Chiranjeevi.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Chiranjeevi won the Indian Film Personality Award in 2022, as awarded by IFFI.**

 
 
• ** Chiranjeevi is a renowned actor and politician from Andhra Pradesh, India, who has acted in over 150 films in Telugu, Tamil, and Hindi languages.**
 
 
 
• Prakash Raj is another well-known Indian actor who has won several awards, including five National Film Awards. However, he did not win the Indian Film Personality Award in 2022.
 
• Mahesh Babu is a popular Telugu actor who has won several awards, including four Filmfare Awards. He also did not win the Indian Film Personality Award in 2022.
 
• Rajnikant is a legendary actor from Tamil Nadu, India, who has acted in over 150 films in Tamil, Telugu, and Hindi languages. He is also a cultural icon in India and has a massive fan following. However, he did not win the Indian Film Personality Award in 2022.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 1, Chiranjeevi.
